## Activity

During August 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 33 captures. Activity for the month is recorded for operational monitoring and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total should continue to be checked against local records so that any differences can be identified promptly and resolved through routine site processes.

## Image quality

Of the completed captures, 2 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.1. The result should be reviewed as part of ongoing quality monitoring, with attention given to recurring camera issues that may affect the usability of captured images. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and service improvement.

## Grading

There were 11 referable results during August 2025. The median grading lag was 1. This information should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality findings when reviewing site operations. Maintaining clear records of captures, ungradable outcomes and grading results will support continued oversight at North City Eye Clinic and help identify any need for further operational action.
